tone.voice: a well-travelled friend who has been everywhere and knows all the best spots — inspiring but practical
tone.avoid: corporate, generic, overly cautious, tourist-trap feeling

trust_signals: response time and acceptance rate for hosts
ux_norms: full-bleed destination photography dominates every screen — never small thumbnails for destinations
map view is always an alternative to list view for any location-based content
price transparency — total cost always shown before any commitment step
reviews and photos from real travellers drive decisions — always show review count not just rating
trip planner screens: home shows active trip progress and countdown to departure — never generic discover feed
trip planner screens: trip overview uses day tabs — swipe between Day 1, Day 2 etc as primary navigation
trip planner screens: day plan uses timeline view — hour by hour, activities in chronological order with gaps visible
trip planner screens: add activity always offers search first — never blank form first
trip planner screens: map view shows all activities as numbered pins matching the day plan order
trip planner screens: packing list uses category sections with progress bar — percentage packed always visible
trip planner screens: group collaboration shows member avatars on any shared content — always visible who added what
trip planner screens: budget tracker shows remaining budget prominently — ring chart, not just a number
trip planner screens: travel documents show expiry date with colour coded urgency — amber 30 days, red 7 days
offline access indicators always visible for downloaded trip content — critical when travelling internationally

visual_language.style: stunning destination photography — wide landscapes, golden hour, authentic local life
photography_rules: always use high quality destination and lifestyle photography
golden hour and natural light strongly preferred
authentic local culture over staged tourist imagery
wide angle for landscapes, intimate for experiences
never use generic travel stock photography
visual_language.background_treatment: photography-first — UI overlays are semi-transparent. Clean white for detail screens.
visual_language.empty_state_style: friendly SVG — compass, map pin, or plane — with inspiring copy
visual_language.onboarding_visual: stunning destination photography or warm flat vector illustration — wanderlust theme
visual_language.illustration_style: when used: warm flat vector — maps, landmarks, travel icons

compliance_notes: local tourism licensing requirements vary by region
GDPR for traveller data and preferences
cancellation and refund policy must be prominent
tax collection requirements vary by jurisdiction

avoid: Never show a destination without photography — imagery is the emotional driver of travel decisions
Never hide visa requirements or entry restrictions for a destination
Never show pricing without specifying the currency
Never use a countdown timer on flight or hotel availability without it being accurate
Never make cancellation terms hard to find — they must be prominent before booking
Never show accommodation without showing the exact address or neighbourhood — location drives decisions
enforce: Destination photography always full bleed — no borders or card containers on hero imagery
Cancellation policy always visible before booking confirmation
Total price including taxes and fees always shown — no hidden costs at checkout
Travel advisory and safety information always available for destination
Local time at destination always shown alongside home timezone
Offline access to booking confirmations and tickets always available

Marketplace.headline: Find a place that feels like home
